candidates.old:
.check_if_mover_Y_is_on_screen
    LDA movers_type_and_colour,Y    \ Mover type (get_mover_Y_type inlined)
    AND #&7F
    TAX
.check_if_mover_is_on_screen
    LDY &C5
    CPY viewport_right_high
    BCC is_left_of_viewport_right
    BNE leave_with_carry_set_rts_2097\ Grind: C=1 from the CPY; equal (the common case) falls through
.check_x_low_2099
    LDA viewport_right_low
    CMP mover_x_low
    BCC leave_with_carry_set_2097
.is_left_c1_3d13                    \ Grind: C=1 here on both ways in (the CMP, or the SEC below)
    LDA mover_types_width_table,X
    ADC mover_x_low                 \ x + width + 1
    BCS overflow_c1_3d13            \ the rare carry out of line, so the hot path falls through
.skip_overflow_c1_3d13
    SBC viewport_left_low           \ C=0: x + width + 1 - left_low - 1, the CMP's carry; Y:A >= viewport_left as one 16-bit compare
    TYA
    SBC viewport_left_high
    BCC leave_with_carry_set_2097
.leave_with_carry_clear_20b2
    CLC                             \ Leave with carry clear to indicate mover is on screen
    RTS
.is_left_of_viewport_right          \ the BCC from check_if_mover_is_on_screen: C=0
    SEC
candidates.new:
.check_if_mover_Y_is_on_screen
    LDA movers_type_and_colour,Y    \ Mover type (get_mover_Y_type inlined)
    AND #&7F
    TAX
.check_if_mover_is_on_screen
    LDA viewport_right_low          \ Grind: the right edge as one 16-bit compare, right - x, Y not loaded: C=1 if x <= viewport_right
    CMP mover_x_low
    LDA viewport_right_high
    SBC &C5
    BCC leave_with_carry_set_2097
    LDA mover_types_width_table,X   \ C=1 here
    ADC mover_x_low                 \ x + width + 1
    BCS g9e8f_overflow              \ the rare carry out of line, so the hot path falls through
    SBC viewport_left_low           \ C=0: x + width + 1 - left_low - 1, the CMP's carry; &C5:A >= viewport_left as one 16-bit compare
    LDA &C5
.g9e8f_high
    SBC viewport_left_high
    BCC leave_with_carry_set_2097
.leave_with_carry_clear_20b2
    CLC                             \ Leave with carry clear to indicate mover is on screen
    RTS
.skip_overflow_c1_3d13              \ Grind: the overflow paths below (Y = &C5 or &C5 + 1), as the original compared them
    SBC viewport_left_low
    TYA
    BRA g9e8f_high                  \ 65C02 opcode
.g9e8f_overflow
    LDY &C5                         \ Grind: Y is dead on every exit; only the carry out of line needs it (the INY below)
    CMP #&00                        \ LDY spoiled Z: A = x + width + 1 (low) as the ADC left it, so Z for the BNE below; C = 1
is_left_c1_3d13 = * + 2             \ the BRA below (2 bytes) lands on overflow_c1_3d13
candidates.summary: check_if_mover_is_on_screen: the right edge as one 16-bit compare (LDA vr_low; CMP x_low; LDA vr_high; SBC &C5; BCC off: 14 cycles on the common path, 15 off-screen, against 18/19 and the Y<right path's 14 plus its SEC/BRA), so Y is not loaded and the tail reads &C5 (LDA, 1 cycle dearer than TYA) while the rare carry out of line loads Y itself (LDY &C5; CMP #0 for the Z the BNE after the ADC tests) and the original's INY/DEC A code and a TYA tail copy serve it unchanged. Y is dead on every exit. Built in a scratch copy (bench build, HEAD 3db31c8 vs HEAD + this): pcprof work a pass seed 1 1500 passes -41 (render -19, logic -22), holding RIGHT 600 passes -43; passlock seeds 1 and 3, 4000 passes, state and screen identical; the overflow paths run 67 times in 2500 passes (58 INY, 9 DEC A). +5 bytes: everything after the routine to &3400 slides up 5 (that is in the measured figures).
candidates.equivalence: Off-screen test: old = C5 > vr_high, or equal and vr_low < x_low. New = vr_high - C5 - (vr_low < x_low) borrows: C5 > vr_high borrows whatever the low borrow (difference <= -1), equal borrows iff vr_low < x_low, C5 < vr_high does not (difference >= 1, minus at most 1). The BCC takes leave_with_carry_set_2097 (SEC; RTS) as before; the old BNE leave_with_carry_set_rts_2097 and BCC to the SEC/BRA stub are gone with the compare they belonged to. On the fall-through C=1, which the ADC width needs (x + width + 1) exactly as both old ways in had it. No overflow: C=0 from the ADC, SBC left_low then high byte &C5 (LDA in place of TYA: same value, Y was &C5) SBC left_high, the same 16-bit compare, same CLC/RTS and BCC to the SEC; RTS. Overflow (BCS): the stub loads Y = &C5 (the value the old LDY had loaded), then CMP #0 sets Z = (A == 0) and C = 1 exactly as the ADC left them (A = x_low + width + 1 mod 256: Z from the ADC was the same test), then the BRA +0 (is_left_c1_3d13 = * + 2 is the old BRA's target, overflow_c1_3d13) runs the original's BNE/DEC A/INY/CLC code untouched, which returns to skip_overflow_c1_3d13, now SBC left_low; TYA; BRA g9e8f_high, the old tail with Y = &C5 or &C5 + 1. Exits: C as before on every path (set off-screen, clear on-screen); X (the type) untouched on every path; A and Z/N/V differ from the old exits (they differed between the old paths already); Y was &C5 (or &C5 + 1) on the old exits and is now whatever the caller had (the mover index in plot_mover) on the hot paths and &C5/&C5+1 on the overflow ones: every caller has Y dead (plot_mover: get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses starts LDY mover and the off-screen exit goes straight to RTS; mark_to_draw: BCS next -> LDY ren_k; check_if_mover_Y_is_on_screen callers: search_for_target_with_offset's callers reload Y or branch to get_mover_frame_and_flip (LDY mover_to_update) and calculate_mover_x_max_from_offset writes Y before reading it; consider_mover_firing_grenade: get_mover_frame_and_flip writes Y first). &C5 is not modified. No interrupt reads these zero-page temporaries.
candidates.relies_on: Y dead on exit of check_if_mover_is_on_screen/check_if_mover_Y_is_on_screen for every caller (checked: game.6502 plot_mover ~1925, search_for_target_with_offset 4008, consider_mover_firing_grenade 4926, render.6502 mark_to_draw 1032); the outside-window lines after the window kept as they are (BRA is_left_c1_3d13, .overflow_c1_3d13 .. BRA skip_overflow_c1_3d13) and used: is_left_c1_3d13 = * + 2 only holds while the BRA that follows is 2 bytes; `BRA is_left_c1_3d13` there becomes a BRA +0 on the rare path. Page crossings: the routine's own branches are all on page &1C (BCC to leave_with_carry_set_2097 at &1C6C is a backward same-page branch from both sites); the +5 bytes slide everything from the old &1CBE (completion_screen on, to unused_3400_original: 193 bytes free, SKIP shrinks) up by 5 - the measured pcprof figures above include every crossing that moves (net -41/-43 cycles a pass, i.e. the slide cost nothing visible).
